choices: Atlas Mountains
Himalayas
Andes
Urals

questions.question: Which ocean lies south of the Indian subcontinent?
choices: Indian Ocean
Atlantic Ocean
Arctic Ocean
Southern Ocean

questions.question: Which country occupies much of the delta formed by the Ganges and Brahmaputra rivers?
choices: Nepal
Sri Lanka
Bhutan
Bangladesh

choices: Mekong
Yangtze
Indus
Niger

questions.question: Which South Asian country is an island southeast of India?
choices: Sri Lanka
Nepal
Bhutan
Pakistan

questions.question: Which plateau covers much of peninsular India?
choices: Tibetan Plateau
Deccan Plateau
Colorado Plateau
Anatolian Plateau

questions.question: What is a monsoon?
choices: A permanent ocean current flowing westward
A daily reversal of mountain temperatures
A seasonal shift in prevailing winds
A river that flows only through deserts

questions.question: Why are the timing and strength of summer monsoon rains important to South Asian farming?
choices: All farms use seawater rather than rainfall
The monsoon determines national borders each year
Rainfall affects only coastal fishing, not crops
Many crops and water supplies depend on seasonal rainfall

questions.question: Why do the Indo-Gangetic plains support extensive agriculture?
choices: River deposits and water supplies support productive soils
The plains have no seasonal weather changes
The region is covered entirely by mountain glaciers
The plains lack connections with nearby settlements

questions.question: Why is Bangladesh particularly exposed to river flooding?
choices: Its rivers drain away from all settled areas
Low-lying delta land receives water from large upstream basins
Its entire territory lies above the Himalayan snow line
Its climate has no rainy season

questions.question: How can high mountains influence transportation in Nepal and Bhutan?
choices: They make all routes equally direct
They remove the need for bridges
They prevent every form of regional trade
They can make routes longer and infrastructure more difficult to build

questions.question: Why is South Asia better understood as culturally diverse rather than culturally uniform?
choices: The region has no shared historical connections
Only one language is spoken throughout it
It contains many languages, religions, and regional traditions
Cultural identities follow only elevation boundaries

questions.question: What geographic risk is especially relevant to the low-lying islands of the Maldives?
choices: Coastal flooding and sea-level rise
Avalanches from high mountain glaciers
Permafrost thaw across inland tundra
Winter blizzards on continental grasslands

questions.question: How can Himalayan snow and glacier melt affect communities far downstream?
choices: It determines the language spoken in every coastal city
It contributes water to rivers used by distant settlements
It prevents rivers from carrying sediment
It turns all downstream farmland into deserts

questions.question: Why does a landlocked country such as Nepal depend on routes through neighboring countries for ocean trade?
choices: Landlocked countries cannot manufacture goods
International trade requires a coastline in every trading country
Landlocked countries have no rivers or roads
It lacks direct access to seaports within its own territory

questions.question: A farmer receives much less monsoon rain than usual. Which consequence is most directly plausible?
choices: Farmers may shift harvest dates without any change in water needs
Lower rainfall directly increases the fertility of all soils
Water shortages may reduce crop yields
Lower rainfall necessarily increases yields of water-intensive crops

questions.question: Which route moves from northern highlands toward southern peninsular India?
choices: Himalayas → Indo-Gangetic plains → Deccan Plateau
Deccan Plateau → Himalayas → Indo-Gangetic plains
Indo-Gangetic plains → Deccan Plateau → Himalayas
Himalayas → Deccan Plateau → Indo-Gangetic plains

questions.question: A dam proposal on a shared South Asian river raises concern in a downstream country. Which issue should negotiators examine?
choices: Only the upstream country's total land area
Effects on water timing, quantity, and downstream uses
Only the number of languages spoken along the river
Only the commercial value of roads near the dam

questions.question: Two Indian cities have different climates despite being in the same country. Which explanation best fits geographic reasoning?
choices: Their shared national government produces the same local weather
Their different voting districts account for the climate contrast
Elevation, latitude, and distance from the sea can differ
Their differences result mainly from the languages spoken

questions.question: Which maps would best help identify flood exposure in a South Asian delta?
choices: Maps of ancient kingdoms and modern postal codes
Maps of writing systems and national flags
Maps of mineral exports and literary traditions
Maps of elevation, rivers, and settlement locations
